articles.title_en: A new estimate for global and country-level employment in agrifood systems
articles.title_cn: 对全球和国家层面农业食品系统就业的新估计
articles.abstract_en: Global and national policy discourse and agendas are moving beyond traditional silos of agriculture, nutrition, health, and climate change to address the challenges facing agrifood systems (AFS) holistically. In this paper, we provide a global estimate of AFS employment using international labour force statistics. Starting from country-level employment data from the International Labor Organization (ILO), disaggregated by economic activity, we present a methodology to fill data gaps in identifying agrifood systems employment. Our final dataset includes 184 countries, covering 99 percent of the global population, with a balanced panel of 149 countries from 2000 to 2021. This panel covering 95 percent of the global population allows us to more confidently discuss the evolution of AFS employment trends at global and regional levels. Overall, close to 1.29 billion people were employed in AFS (868 million in agriculture and 418 million in non-agriculture AFS) in 2021, and 3.78 billion people worldwide live in households linked to AFS-based livelihoods. The largest number of AFS workers is in Asia, while the greatest share of AFS workers out of total employment is in Africa. Across all regions of the world, AFS employment has decreased since 2000, driven primarily by a reduction in agricultural employment. In most regions, non-agricultural AFS employment has maintained a stable share of employment over time, around 10 percent, while representing an increasing share of total AFS employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球和国家政策讨论和议程正在超越农业、营养、健康和气候变化等传统领域，全面应对农业食品系统 (AFS) 面临的挑战。在本文中，我们利用国际劳动力统计数据对 AFS 就业情况进行了全球估计。从国际劳工组织（ILO）按经济活动分类的国家级就业数据出发，我们提出了一种方法来填补确定农业食品系统就业方面的数据空白。我们的最终数据集包括184个国家，覆盖99%的全球人口，以及从2000到2021的149个国家的平衡面板。该小组覆盖了全球人口的95%，使我们能够更加自信地讨论全球和区域层面 AFS 就业趋势的演变。总体而言，2021有近1.29十亿人在AFS就业（868百万从事农业，418百万从事非农业AFS），全世界有3.78十亿人生活在与基于AFS的生计相关的家庭中。 AFS 工人数量最多的是亚洲，而 AFS 工人占总就业人数的比例最大的是非洲。自2000以来，世界所有地区的 AFS 就业人数均有所下降，这主要是由于农业就业人数的减少。在大多数地区，非农 AFS 就业人数一直保持稳定的就业比例，约为 10%，同时在 AFS 总就业人数中所占比例不断增加。

articles.title_en: The contentious history of Mao-era policies requiring cadres to participate in labor and workers to participate in management
articles.title_cn: 毛泽东时代要求干部参加劳动和工人参加管理的政策争议史
articles.abstract_en: During the Mao era in China, factory leaders, managers, and technicians were required to participate in manual labor and workers were required to participate in management. The declared purpose of these “two participations” policies was to diminish the differences between mental and manual labor. In Marxist theory, this gap was a fundamental feature of class societies, and closing the gap became one of the key goals of the radical class-leveling agenda pursued by the Chinese Communist Party after the 1949 Revolution. As was pointed out in the introduction to this special issue, the CCP took this agenda more seriously than other communist parties that came to power in the 20th century. Based on an analysis of articles published in the People’s Daily (the party’s flagship newspaper) as well as interviews with workers and cadres employed in industrial enterprises during the Mao and early Reform eras, this paper investigates the contentious goals, policies, practices, and institutions associated with these two slogans. Our analysis reveals accomplishments but also demonstrates the profound challenges this endeavor entailed. We find that the distinctions between mental and manual labor proved to be a far more resilient foundation of class hierarchies than property ownership.
articles.abstract_cn: 在中国毛泽东时代，工厂领导、管理人员和技术人员被要求参加体力劳动，工人被要求参加管理。这些“两参”政策的公开目的是缩小脑力劳动与体力劳动之间的差别。在马克思主义理论中，这一差距是阶级社会的基本特征，缩小这一差距成为中国共产党在1949年革命后推行的激进阶级平等议程的关键目标之一。正如本期特刊导言所指出的，中国共产党比20世纪上台的其他共产党更加认真地对待这一议程。基于对《人民日报》（党的旗舰报纸）发表文章的分析，以及对毛泽东时代和改革初期工业企业中工人和干部的访谈，本文考察了与这两个口号相关的争议性目标、政策、实践和制度。我们的分析揭示了成就，但也展示了这一努力所面临的深刻挑战。我们发现，脑力劳动与体力劳动之间的区别被证明是比财产所有权更为顽固的阶级等级基础。

articles.title_en: Development as life-making
articles.title_cn: 发展作为生命创造
articles.abstract_en: Building on critiques of Development as both immanent and intentional process, this contribution advances a vision of Development as life-making, grounded in a global feminist political economy approach centred on the concept of social reproduction. Moving beyond the methodological nationalism of many productivist paradigms, it redirects Development toward the regeneration of social, economic, and ecological conditions that sustain life; the dismantling of intersectional and existential inequalities; and the pursuit of social and economic justice. This new vision and definition restructure Development priorities along three axes: reproductive labour, life-sustaining sectors, and surplus populations. This reframing brings theoretical, political, and policy agendas into alignment with a project of planetary social justice, drawing on the diverse legacy of social reproduction feminism.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于对发展作为内在和有意过程的批判，本文提出了一种将发展视为生命创造的愿景，该愿景植根于以社会再生产概念为核心的全球女性主义政治经济学方法。超越许多生产主义范式的方法论民族主义，它将发展重新导向维持生命的社会、经济及生态条件的再生；消除交叉性和存在性不平等；以及追求社会和经济正义。这一新愿景和定义将发展的优先事项重构为三个轴心：再生产劳动、维持生命的部门以及剩余人口。这种重新框架使理论、政治和政策议程与行星社会正义项目保持一致，借鉴了社会再生产女性主义的多元遗产。

articles.title_en: The American dream revisited: intergenerational education mobility in immigrant households
articles.title_cn: 美国梦再探：移民家庭中的代际教育流动性
articles.abstract_en: This study uses American Community Survey microdata from 2005 to 2019 to investigate the interactive effect of parents’ education and immigrant status on their children’s economic and education outcomes. We find a significant positive correlation between the education achievements of parents and those of their children, which diminishes for immigrant parents. However, the low transmissibility likely reflects the upward mobility of immigrant children, who may surpass their parents’ and native children’s education levels, despite starting from similar or lower educational baselines. The influence of immigrant parents’ education on their children’s outcomes is complex, involving parental nurturing, pecuniary constraints, socioeconomic disparities, foreign credential non‑recognition, language barriers and cultural hurdles. Our findings present a nuanced picture. While the translation of educational mobility into broader economic mobility remains incomplete, there is a positive association between educational mobility and labor income mobility. Importantly, the analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity across immigrant subgroups. Distinct patterns emerge between immigrants from developed and developing countries, and intergenerational mobility outcomes also vary by parental race—particularly in families with Black fathers. These findings shed light on the challenges and implications of immigrant parents’ education for their children’s outcomes and emphasize the need to address these unique obstacles to secure the success of future generations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用2005年至2019年的美国社区调查微观数据，探讨父母教育程度与移民身份对其子女经济和教育成果的交互影响。我们发现，父母的教育成就与其子女的教育成就之间存在显著的正相关关系，但这种相关性在移民父母中有所减弱。然而，这种低传递性可能反映了移民子女的向上流动性，他们尽管起始教育基线相似或较低，但可能超越其父母及本土子女的教育水平。移民父母教育对其子女成果的影响是复杂的，涉及父母养育、经济约束、社会经济差距、外国学历不被认可、语言障碍和文化障碍等因素。我们的研究结果呈现了一幅细致入微的画面。虽然教育流动性向更广泛的经济流动性的转化尚不完整，但教育流动性与劳动收入流动性之间存在正相关关系。重要的是，分析揭示了不同移民亚群体之间的显著异质性。来自发达国家和发展中国家的移民呈现出不同的模式，代际流动性结果也因父母种族而异——尤其是在有黑人父亲的家庭中。这些发现揭示了移民父母教育对其子女成果的挑战和影响，并强调了解决这些独特障碍以确保未来几代人成功的必要性。

articles.title_en: Investigating resilience of refugee households in Jordan
articles.title_cn: 约旦难民家庭韧性研究
articles.abstract_en: As of 2024, Jordan hosts over 1.3 million refugees—one of the highest refugee-to-host population ratios globally—posing significant challenges for sustaining refugee household livelihoods. To inform effective support strategies, this study quantifies household resilience using quarterly UNHCR data from 2022. We conceptualize resilience as the ability to maintain a minimum, normatively defined level of well-being when exposed to potential stressors. We focus on two core welfare indicators (real per-capita income and expenditure) and extend existing approaches by estimating the joint conditional probability that both indicators remain above defined normative thresholds. We further examine how resilience relates to dependence on unconditional cash assistance using household panel data with fixed effects, a framework designed to account for unobserved heterogeneity and mitigate targeting bias. Results show that: (i) resilience is higher in wealthier and less densely populated Governorates; (ii) average resilience declined across the four quarters of year 2022; (iii) lower resilience is observed among Syrian households and those residing outside Amman; and (iv) assistance displays a robust contemporaneous positive association with resilience, especially among more dependent and vulnerable households. Although primarily descriptive, these patterns offer indicative insights for refining targeting strategies and designing resilience-oriented social protection programs in protracted displacement settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 截至2024年，约旦收容了超过1.3万难民——这是全球难民与收容人口比例最高的国家之一——对维持难民家庭生计构成了重大挑战。为制定有效的支持策略，本研究利用2022年度的季度联合国难民署数据量化了家庭韧性。我们将韧性定义为在面临潜在压力源时维持最低规范福祉水平的能力。我们聚焦于两个核心福利指标（实际人均收入和支出），并通过估计两个指标均保持在既定规范阈值以上的联合条件概率来扩展现有方法。我们进一步利用带有固定效应的家庭面板数据考察韧性对无条件现金援助依赖的关系，该框架旨在控制不可观测的异质性并减轻目标定位偏差。结果显示：（i）较富裕且人口密度较低的省份韧性更高；（ii）2022年四个季度的平均韧性有所下降；（iii）叙利亚家庭及居住在安曼以外的家庭韧性较低；（iv）援助与韧性表现出稳健的同期正相关，尤其是在更依赖和更脆弱的家庭中。尽管这些模式主要是描述性的，但它们为完善目标定位策略和在长期流离失所环境中设计以韧性为导向的社会保护计划提供了指示性见解。

articles.title_en: From classrooms to crime prevention: The incapacitation effect of extending the school day in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 从课堂到犯罪预防：墨西哥延长在校时间的监禁效应
articles.abstract_en: Does lengthening the school day incapacitate youth from criminal and deviant behavior? We address this question by leveraging exogenous variation in time spent in school generated by the introduction of the Full-Time Schools Program (FTS) in Mexico. FTS extended the school day from 4.5 to 8 hours and was implemented through a staggered rollout across municipalities. Using municipal-level crime data from the school years 2010/11 to 2016/17, we exploit variation in program adoption timing to estimate the causal effects of an extended school day on crime. Results from a dynamic event-study model show that FTS reduces common robbery by 11% relative to the base-year level, with no significant effects on other minor crimes or serious felonies. The effects are concentrated in middle schools (ages 12–14) and in municipalities with lower socioeconomic status, a critical age range associated with the onset of delinquent behavior and the formation of criminal trajectories. Our findings are robust to treatment-effect heterogeneity under staggered implementation and to potential contamination from the parallel Secure Schools program. We further corroborate these results using judicially reviewed juvenile crime data for adolescents aged 12–17. In addition, we show that middle-school dropout rates declined, while enrollment and teacher–student ratios were unaffected, suggesting no evidence of overcrowding. Overall, our results provide strong evidence of an incapacitation effect and highlight education policies as an effective crime-prevention strategy during early adolescence.
articles.abstract_cn: 延长在校时间能否使青少年免于犯罪和偏差行为？我们利用墨西哥全日制学校计划（FTS）引入所产生的在校时间外生变化来回答这一问题。FTS将学校日从4.5小时延长至8小时，并通过在各市镇分阶段推广实施。利用2010/11至2016/17学年市镇层面的犯罪数据，我们利用项目采用时间的差异来估计延长在校时间对犯罪的因果效应。动态事件研究模型的结果显示，相对于基年水平，FTS使普通抢劫减少了11%，对其他轻微犯罪或严重重罪没有显著影响。这些效应集中在中学（12-14岁）和社会经济地位较低的市镇，这一关键年龄段与 delinquent 行为的起始和犯罪轨迹的形成相关。我们的发现在分阶段实施下的处理效应异质性以及来自并行的安全学校计划的潜在污染方面均具有稳健性。我们进一步使用12-17岁青少年经司法审查的青少年犯罪数据证实了这些结果。此外，我们显示中学辍学率下降，而入学率和师生比未受影响，表明没有拥挤的证据。总体而言，我们的结果提供了监禁效应的有力证据，并强调教育政策是青少年早期有效的犯罪预防策略。

articles.title_en: Can reminders promote regular pro-environmental behavior? Experimental evidence from Peru
articles.title_cn: 提醒能否促进规律性的亲环境行为？来自秘鲁的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Pro-environmental behavior, such as recycling, often needs to be regular to be effective, and interventions to encourage behavioral change may therefore need to be repeated; yet, little evidence exists on the optimal time pattern and frequency of such repeated interventions. To fill this gap, we investigate the impact of mobile text reminders on households’ recycling behavior in urban Peru by randomly varying the exposure length and continuity of reminders. We find that reminders increase both the likelihood that households start to recycle and the frequency of recycling among households that already did so before the intervention. The effects are stronger when reminders are repeated over a longer period. Our findings suggest that both limited attention and habit formation matter for recycling behavior, and that low-cost mobile text reminders can effectively support regular pro-environmental behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 亲环境行为，如回收利用，往往需要规律性才能有效，因此鼓励行为改变的干预措施可能需要重复进行；然而，关于此类重复干预的最佳时间模式和频率的证据很少。为填补这一空白，我们通过随机改变提醒的暴露时长和连续性，研究了手机短信提醒对秘鲁城市家庭回收行为的影响。我们发现，提醒既增加了家庭开始回收的可能性，也增加了干预前已进行回收的家庭的回收频率。当提醒在更长时期内重复时，效果更强。我们的研究结果表明，有限注意力和习惯形成对回收行为都很重要，低成本手机短信提醒能有效支持规律性的亲环境行为。

articles.title_en: Green finance and labor income share: evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融与劳动收入份额：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by the global trend of green and low-carbon transformation and the dual-carbon goal, the development of China’s green finance has been expedited. Based on the data of Chinese listed companies, this paper examines the influence of green finance development on the labor share. We find that (1) The development of green finance exerts a negative effect on the overall labor income share of enterprises, primarily through accelerating the substitution of capital for labor and enhancing enterprise productivity. (2) The impact of green finance on the labor income share is more significant for heavily polluting enterprises, non-state-owned enterprises, and labor-intensive enterprises. (3) The strong bargaining power of workers within the firm and the acquisition of government subsidies effectively mitigate the negative impact of green finance on the labor income share. Nevertheless, the increase in labor costs intensifies the negative impact of green finance on the labor income share. (4) Regional-level analysis indicates that green finance has promoted the allocation of labor from the polluting sector to the clean sector. Green finance only has a reducing effect on the labor income share in heavily polluting sectors, and its overall impact on the regional labor income share is not remarkable.
articles.abstract_cn: 受全球绿色低碳转型趋势和双碳目标的推动，中国绿色金融的发展得以加速。基于中国上市公司数据，本文考察了绿色金融发展对劳动份额的影响。我们发现：（1）绿色金融的发展对企业整体劳动收入份额产生负面影响，主要通过加速资本对劳动的替代和提高企业生产率实现。（2）绿色金融对劳动收入份额的影响在重污染企业、非国有企业和劳动密集型企业中更为显著。（3）企业内部工人较强的议价能力和获得政府补贴有效缓解了绿色金融对劳动收入份额的负面影响。然而，劳动力成本的增加加剧了绿色金融对劳动收入份额的负面影响。（4）区域层面分析表明，绿色金融促进了劳动力从污染部门向清洁部门的配置。绿色金融仅对重污染部门的劳动收入份额具有降低效应，其对区域整体劳动收入份额的影响并不显著。

articles.title_en: When it rains, it pours: On the spillover effects of corruption on firms’ tax evasion
articles.title_cn: 祸不单行：论腐败对企业逃税的外溢效应
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the direct and spillover effects of corruption on firms’ tax evasion in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), a region plagued by both phenomena. Firm-level data on 17 SSA economies spanning 2008–2014 were sourced from the World Bank’s Enterprise Survey. I instrument for endogeneity of corruption using five variables, namely the number of days it takes to (i) clear exports, (ii) clear imports, (iii) obtain an operating license, (iv) time spent by senior management on regulatory compliance, and (v) the extent to which business licenses and permits are an obstacle the firm’s operation. I implemented a battery of endogeneity-correcting estimators: traditional instrumental-variable two-stage least squares (2SLS), Lewbel’s 2SLS, Oster’s bounding analysis, propensity score matching, and Kinky Least Squares. I find that corruption of tax officials (i.e., bribe expected/requested in exchange for a favourable tax inspection) significantly increases tax evasion. More critically, this study challenges prevailing assumptions from European and Central Asian contexts by demonstrating that corruption outside tax authorities—specifically bribes expected/requested in exchange for operating licenses and government contracts—also exerts substantial adverse spillover effect on tax compliance. Firms that perceived/experienced bribe requests in exchange for obtaining operating licenses evaded taxes at rates 24.2 percentage points higher than their counterparts who did not perceive/experience bribe requests in exchange for obtaining operating licenses. In contrast, a percent increase in perceived bribe rates for government contracts corresponded to a 2.1 percentage-point increase in tax evasion. Mediation analysis identifies working capital depletion as a key transmission channel. These findings underscore the need for multisectoral anti-corruption strategies to effectively combat tax evasion and enhance domestic revenue mobilisation in SSA.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）地区腐败对企业逃税的直接效应和外溢效应，该地区同时深受这两种现象困扰。研究使用了世界银行企业调查中涵盖2008-2014年17个SSA经济体的企业层面数据。我使用五个变量作为腐败内生性的工具变量，即（i）出口清关所需天数，（ii）进口清关所需天数，（iii）获得经营许可证所需天数，（iv）高级管理层用于合规监管的时间，以及（v）营业执照和许可证对企业运营构成障碍的程度。我实施了一系列纠正内生性的估计方法：传统工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）、Lewbel的2SLS、Oster的边界分析、倾向得分匹配和Kinky最小二乘法。我发现税务官员的腐败（即期望/要求贿赂以换取有利的税务检查）显著增加了逃税行为。更重要的是，本研究挑战了来自欧洲和中亚背景的普遍假设，证明税务机关之外的腐败——特别是为获得经营许可证和政府合同而期望/要求的贿赂——也对税收合规产生了显著的不利外溢效应。感知/经历为获得经营许可证而被索贿的企业，其逃税率比未感知/经历此类索贿的企业高出24.2个百分点。相比之下，感知到的政府合同贿赂率每增加一个百分点，逃税率相应增加2.1个百分点。中介分析识别出营运资金枯竭是一个关键的传导渠道。这些发现强调了采取多部门反腐败策略以有效打击逃税并增强SSA国内收入动员的必要性。

articles.title_en: Biodiversity conservation and contestations over land: Jihadist expansion in West Africa
articles.title_cn: 生物多样性保护与土地争议：西非的圣战扩张
articles.abstract_en: Protected areas in Africa are sites of resource-related grievances and are located within socio-ecological landscapes where insurgent groups have increasingly operated. The connection between insurgency and protected areas is widely seen as resulting from resistance to coercive conservation, or from the role that protected areas serve as insurgent refuges. Research in Benin’s National Park W reveals that its emergence as a site of insurgency is shaped less by current grievances or refuge than by new forms of power that are grounded in histories of inter-group competition and changes in resource availability within a broader socio-ecological landscape. Long-term fieldwork shows how these landscape-level changes have intersected with different modes of park management to influence relations between managers and livestock herders which have in turn created opportunities for insurgents. Our analysis reveals two contrasting channels through which conservation zoning has shaped insurgent-local relations. The first involves resource users resisting expulsion from wildlife protection areas. The second involves users who align with insurgents to defend rights they have obtained through official park management policy. This channel demonstrates that attempts by managers to accommodate local needs can inadvertently produce new kinds of insurgent-local relationships through a combination of strict territorial management and ambiguous rights in special use zones. These findings point to a more complex etiology of how protected areas become sites of insurgency, highlighting the importance of the interaction of landscape-level resource competition and changing relations between conservation managers and rural inhabitants over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 非洲的保护区是资源相关不满的场所，并且位于叛乱团体日益活动的社会生态景观中。叛乱与保护区之间的联系被广泛视为源于对强制性保护的抵抗，或保护区作为叛乱避难所的作用。在贝宁的W国家公园进行的研究表明，其作为叛乱场所的出现，更多受到基于群体间竞争历史和更广泛社会生态景观中资源可用性变化的新权力形式的影响，而非当前的不满或避难所。长期田野调查显示，这些景观层面的变化如何与不同的公园管理模式相交织，影响管理者与牲畜牧民之间的关系，进而为叛乱分子创造了机会。我们的分析揭示了保护分区塑造叛乱-地方关系的两条对比路径。第一条涉及资源使用者抵抗被驱逐出野生动物保护区。第二条涉及使用者与叛乱分子结盟，以捍卫他们通过官方公园管理政策获得的权利。这条路径表明，管理者试图容纳地方需求的努力，可能通过严格的地域管理和特殊使用区中模糊权利的结合，无意中产生新型的叛乱-地方关系。这些发现指出了保护区成为叛乱场所的更复杂病因，强调了景观层面资源竞争与保护管理者和农村居民之间随时间变化的关系互动的重要性。

articles.title_en: Domestic violence laws and social norms: Evidence from Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 家庭暴力法律与社会规范：来自巴基斯坦的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of Domestic Violence (DV) laws in Pakistan on violence against women. Using both survey data and crime reports, and exploiting the introduction of the laws across different provinces over time, we show that the new laws had little to no effect on DV or femicides in Punjab and Sindh, while they led to an increase in both in Balochistan. The effect in Balochistan is driven by ethnic groups with more conservative attitudes towards DV and divorce. Our findings show that the introduction of laws that conflict with prevailing social norms may risk backfiring.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了巴基斯坦家庭暴力（DV）法律对针对女性的暴力的影响。利用调查数据和犯罪报告，并利用不同省份随时间引入法律的情况，我们表明新法律在旁遮普省和信德省对家庭暴力或杀害女性几乎没有影响，而在俾路支省则导致两者均有所增加。俾路支省的影响由对家庭暴力和离婚持更保守态度的族群驱动。我们的发现表明，引入与现行社会规范相冲突的法律可能面临适得其反的风险。

articles.title_en: Natural disasters and foreign aid allocation: how much, how quickly, and to whom?
articles.title_cn: 自然灾害与外国援助分配：多少、多快、给谁？
articles.abstract_en: Natural disasters provide quasi-experimental variation to study how foreign aid responds to shocks. Using data for 20 bilateral donors for the period going from 1995 to 2021 and a local-projection difference-in-differences design, we estimate the dynamic effects of disasters on aid commitments. Foreign aid rises significantly in the aftermath of shocks, but the response is short-lived and disproportionately benefits middle-income countries. Humanitarian aid reacts quickly, while development aid adjusts more slowly. The findings reveal persistent inequities in global disaster relief.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然灾害为准实验变异提供了研究外国援助如何应对冲击的机会。利用1995年至2021年间20个双边捐助国的数据，并采用局部投影双重差分设计，我们估计了灾害对援助承诺的动态影响。外国援助在冲击发生后显著增加，但反应短暂且不成比例地惠及中等收入国家。人道主义援助反应迅速，而发展援助调整较慢。研究结果揭示了全球灾害救济中持续存在的不平等现象。

articles.title_en: Trading peace for hazard management? peace agreement implementation and United Nations peace operations during natural hazards
articles.title_cn: 以和平换取灾害管理？自然灾害期间的和平协议执行与联合国和平行动
articles.abstract_en: Although United Nations Peace Operations (UNPOs) can strengthen capacity and improve responses to natural hazards, the core peace operation and ability to produce peace can become victims of crisis management success. Natural hazards can impede UNPOs’ activities and peace accord implementation through three mechanisms: 1) UNPOs activities are diverted to immediate humanitarian assistance, away from core UNPOs’ activities; 2) changes to the bargaining process; and 3) lower opportunity costs of violence and increased opportunities to renege on agreements or call for renegotiations. We compare peace agreement implementation with UNPOs versus peace agreement implementation without UNPOs when facing natural hazards. In an analysis of countries with comprehensive peace agreement implementations between 1992 and 2015 we find that natural hazards during UNPOs deployment see lower subsequent peace agreement implementation relative to hazards in countries without UNPOs. We see these findings as consistent with greater dependency on UNPOs, creating greater tension between responses to natural hazards and peace implementation. Further analysis to unpack the three mechanisms suggests support for the first two mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管联合国和平行动（UNPOs）能够增强能力并改善对自然灾害的应对，但核心和平行动及产生和平的能力可能成为危机管理成功的牺牲品。自然灾害可通过三种机制阻碍联合国和平行动的活动及和平协议的执行：1）联合国和平行动的活动被转向即时人道主义援助，偏离核心联合国和平行动的活动；2）谈判过程的变化；以及3）暴力机会成本的降低和违约或要求重新谈判机会的增加。我们比较了面临自然灾害时，有联合国和平行动参与的和平协议执行与无联合国和平行动参与的和平协议执行情况。在对1992年至2015年间全面和平协议执行国家的分析中，我们发现，与没有联合国和平行动的国家相比，联合国和平行动部署期间发生自然灾害的国家，其后续和平协议执行程度较低。我们认为这些发现与对联合国和平行动的更大依赖性一致，这种依赖性在自然灾害应对与和平执行之间造成了更大的紧张关系。进一步分析以揭示这三种机制，结果支持前两种机制。

articles.title_en: Political change in African cities: transforming state-society relations
articles.title_cn: 非洲城市的政治变迁：重塑国家与社会关系
articles.abstract_en: African countries are undergoing a transformative urban transition that has profound implications for the continent and across the globe. Given its importance, research has extensively explored the social and economic implications of both the shift from rural to urban modes of living and rapid growth of urban settlements. This article considers the political dimension of urbanization in African countries, which has been somewhat overlooked despite African cities becoming significant political territories and sites of social mobilisation and new political movements. It argues that the changing nature of how and where people live across the continent can reshape state-society relations and foster political change, but the specific ways it may do so remain unclear and under theorized. Further, we maintain that the ways in which urbanization shapes political outcomes is heterogenous, and relates to both the context of individual places and the specific process of urban change. To develop this, we review the nascent literature on how urban change and political change may co-emerge, and outline an analytical framework to understand the nature of urban and political change in African societies. We then show how such a framework can be applied to synthesise new research on urbanization and changing state-society relations at different scales, and identify implications for future research agendas on the changing politics of African cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 非洲国家正在经历一场深刻的城市转型，这对非洲大陆及全球都具有深远影响。鉴于其重要性，研究已广泛探讨了从农村向城市生活方式的转变以及城市聚落快速增长的社会和经济影响。本文关注非洲国家城市化的政治维度，尽管非洲城市已成为重要的政治领土、社会动员和新政治运动的场所，这一维度在某种程度上被忽视了。本文认为，非洲大陆人们生活方式和居住地点的变化性质可以重塑国家与社会关系并促进政治变迁，但其具体方式仍不明确且理论化不足。此外，我们认为城市化塑造政治结果的方式是异质性的，既与具体地点的背景相关，也与城市变迁的具体过程相关。为发展这一论点，我们回顾了关于城市变迁与政治变迁可能共同出现的新兴文献，并概述了一个分析框架，以理解非洲社会中城市与政治变迁的性质。然后，我们展示了如何应用这一框架来综合不同尺度上关于城市化与不断变化的国家与社会关系的新研究，并确定对未来非洲城市政治变迁研究议程的影响。

articles.title_en: Green window of opportunity in Latin America: local and global knowledge linkages
articles.title_cn: 拉丁美洲的绿色机会窗口：本地与全球知识联系
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether the green transition represents a “green window of opportunity” for Latin American countries by examining how local and global knowledge networks shape technological specialisation in the region. We analyse the role of knowledge linkages—both local and global—and their technological nature (green versus non-green) in driving the emergence of new patent specialisations. Using United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) data for 16 Latin American countries between 2000 and 2019, we estimate an entry model that relates the probability of developing new technological specialisations to network cohesion (local collaboration) and connectivity (global collaboration). Our results show that the green transition constitutes a window of opportunity: both local and global network interactions positively and significantly influence entry into new technologies, but only for green technological domains. Furthermore, our results highlight how global collaborations are more influential than local ones.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察本地和全球知识网络如何塑造拉丁美洲国家的技术专业化，探讨绿色转型是否代表着该地区的“绿色机会窗口”。我们分析了知识联系——包括本地和全球——及其技术性质（绿色与非绿色）在推动新专利专业化出现中的作用。利用美国专利商标局（USPTO）2000年至2019年间16个拉丁美洲国家的数据，我们估计了一个进入模型，该模型将发展新技术专业化的概率与网络凝聚力（本地合作）和连通性（全球合作）联系起来。我们的结果表明，绿色转型构成了一个机会窗口：本地和全球网络互动对进入新技术领域均有正向且显著的影响，但仅限于绿色技术领域。此外，我们的结果强调，全球合作比本地合作更具影响力。

articles.title_en: Does women’s financial inclusion reduce corruption? role of socioeconomic and institutional factors
articles.title_cn: 女性金融包容性是否减少了腐败？社会经济与制度因素的作用
articles.abstract_en: Financial inclusion is widely promoted as a pathway to transparency and development, yet its gender-specific governance effects remain underexplored. This study examines the impact of women’s financial inclusion (WFI) on corruption control across 150 countries from 2011 to 2023, using a dynamic System-GMM framework to address endogeneity and persistence. We construct a composite Women’s Financial Inclusion Index (WFII) integrating traditional and digital access indicators and assess robustness using alternative measures. Results reveal a statistically significant U-shaped relationship. At low levels, greater WFI is associated with weaker corruption control; beyond a critical threshold of approximately 1.86 (standardized units), deeper inclusion strengthens governance. A complementary Women’s Digital Financial Inclusion Index (WDFII) exhibits a lower turning point, indicating that digital inclusion generates earlier governance gains. The governance-enhancing impact of WFI is amplified by female education, labor force participation, and stronger institutional quality. Income heterogeneity further shows that lower-income countries experience earlier marginal benefits, whereas upper-middle- and high-income countries require deeper inclusion before governance improvements materialize. Overall, WFI acts as an institutional amplifier, strengthening accountability where supportive legal and socioeconomic conditions are present. Its anti-corruption benefits depend on complementary investments in female human capital, regulatory safeguards, and institutional strength. Effective policy must therefore align financial access expansion, particularly through digital channels, with broader empowerment and governance reforms to ensure inclusion translates into sustained corruption control and inclusive development.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融包容性被广泛视为通往透明度和发展的途径，但其性别特定的治理效应仍未得到充分探讨。本研究利用动态系统GMM框架，考察了2011年至2023年间150个国家中女性金融包容性（WFI）对腐败控制的影响，以解决内生性和持续性问题。我们构建了一个综合性的女性金融包容性指数（WFII），整合了传统和数字接入指标，并使用替代措施评估稳健性。结果显示存在统计上显著的U型关系。在低水平上，较高的WFI与较弱的腐败控制相关；超过约1.86（标准化单位）的关键阈值后，更深入的包容性会加强治理。补充的女性数字金融包容性指数（WDFII）显示出较低的转折点，表明数字包容性更早产生治理收益。WFI的治理增强效应受到女性教育、劳动力参与和更强制度质量的放大。收入异质性进一步表明，低收入国家经历更早的边际收益，而中高收入和高收入国家则需要更深入的包容性才能实现治理改善。总体而言，WFI作为制度放大器，在存在支持性法律和社会经济条件的情况下加强问责制。其反腐败效益取决于对女性人力资本、监管保障和制度实力的补充投资。因此，有效的政策必须将金融接入扩展（特别是通过数字渠道）与更广泛的赋权和治理改革相结合，以确保包容性转化为持续的腐败控制和包容性发展。

articles.title_en: Sanctions, Food Insecurity, and the Mitigating Role of Foreign Investment
articles.title_cn: 制裁、粮食不安全与外国投资的缓解作用
articles.abstract_en: International sanctions can generate substantial humanitarian spillovers by disrupting trade, finance, mobility, and institutional coordination that sustain food systems. Using panel data for 183 countries from 2000 to 2022, and estimating two-step system GMM models complemented by fixed-effects specifications, this study finds that economic, trade, financial, non-economic, and travel sanctions are each associated with significantly higher food insecurity. Foreign direct investment (FDI) plays a mitigating role by supporting local production, economic resilience, and food-system stability. These conclusions are robust to instrumental-variable approaches, alternative sanctions and FDI measures, and production-based mechanism tests. The findings further indicate that food-security outcomes under sanctions depend critically on the functioning of trade, financial, and investment channels, and that FDI operates as a systematic conditioning factor that attenuates sanction-induced shocks rather than as a primary transmission channel of their effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际制裁可能通过扰乱维持粮食系统的贸易、金融、流动性和制度协调，产生重大的人道主义溢出效应。利用2000年至2022年间183个国家的面板数据，并采用两步系统GMM模型辅以固定效应规格进行估计，本研究发现经济、贸易、金融、非经济和旅行制裁均与显著更高的粮食不安全相关联。外国直接投资（FDI）通过支持本地生产、经济韧性和粮食系统稳定性发挥缓解作用。这些结论在工具变量方法、替代制裁和FDI度量以及基于生产机制的检验中均保持稳健。研究结果进一步表明，制裁下的粮食安全结果关键取决于贸易、金融和投资渠道的运作，且FDI作为一个系统性调节因素，削弱了制裁引发的冲击，而非其主要传导渠道。

articles.title_en: Worldwide agroextractivism: A probabilistic approach
articles.title_cn: 全球农业采掘主义：一种概率方法
articles.abstract_en: Agroextractivism has increasingly attracted scientific attention, particularly within and from Latin America. While a substantial body of literature has emerged describing its main characteristics, there remains a significant gap regarding how to define and classify countries as agroextractivist, as well as how to compare the varying degrees or intensities of agroextractivism among them. Moreover, there is a lack of information on the probabilistic trajectories that may lead a country to adopt this model. In this article, we present a novel proposal that addresses both gaps. By applying a multidimensional approach at the global level, we develop an agroextractivism index and conduct a probabilistic analysis using panel data. Our results include the analysis of 23 countries across different regions. Of these, nine are classified as agroextractivist. Through the probabilistic analysis, we identify the variables that influence this process and present probabilistic trajectories for the period 2001–2021. We conclude by acknowledging that while the index provides only a limited perspective, its application allows us to identify a distinctive condition: the varying degrees of emphasis countries place on agricultural extractivism. Some are shifting significantly toward more intensive agricultural practices, while others show a less marked tendency.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业采掘主义日益引起科学关注，尤其是在拉丁美洲及其内部。虽然已有大量文献描述其主要特征，但在如何定义和分类国家为农业采掘主义国家，以及如何比较它们之间农业采掘主义的不同程度或强度方面，仍存在显著空白。此外，关于可能导致一个国家采用这种模式的概率轨迹的信息也缺乏。在本文中，我们提出了一项新颖的提案，以解决这两个空白。通过在全球层面应用多维方法，我们构建了一个农业采掘主义指数，并使用面板数据进行了概率分析。我们的结果包括对23个不同地区国家的分析。其中，九个被归类为农业采掘主义国家。通过概率分析，我们识别了影响这一过程的变量，并呈现了2001-2021时期的概率轨迹。最后，我们承认虽然该指数仅提供了有限的视角，但其应用使我们能够识别一个独特的条件：各国对农业采掘主义重视程度的不同。一些国家正显著转向更集约化的农业实践，而另一些国家则表现出较不明显的趋势。

articles.title_en: Forced migrant arrivals can reduce political trust in African host communities
articles.title_cn: 被迫移民的涌入可能降低非洲收容社区的政治信任
articles.abstract_en: Previous research shows that the arrival of forcibly displaced people may have a considerable impact on the economy and on livelihoods within host communities. This is particularly the case in many African countries, which host many of the world’s refugees, but may have limited capacity to handle sudden influxes of people. Yet the bulk of research on refugee arrivals and public opinion is conducted in wealthy, Western contexts. In this article, we start addressing this gap by assessing the effect of forced displacement on trust in national and local authorities. Theoretically, we draw on the literatures on the consequences of forced migration and political trust. Empirically, we rely on seven rounds of georeferenced Afrobarometer data (N = 228,242) combined with data on migrant settlements from the UNHCR People of Concern database to estimate a set of difference-in-differences regression models. We also test whether individual educational attainment moderates the effect of displacement. We find that camp establishment reduces both forms of political trust, and the effect is more pronounced among host community members with less education. This underscores the importance of human development in bolstering the host community’s coping capacity when new camps are established.
articles.abstract_cn: 先前的研究表明，被迫流离失所者的到来可能对收容社区的经济和生计产生显著影响。这在许多非洲国家尤为突出，这些国家收容了世界上许多难民，但可能处理突然涌入人口的能力有限。然而，关于难民到来与公众舆论的大部分研究是在富裕的西方背景下进行的。在本文中，我们通过评估被迫流离失所对国家和地方当局信任的影响来开始填补这一空白。理论上，我们借鉴了关于被迫移民后果和政治信任的文献。实证上，我们依赖七轮地理参考的非洲晴雨表数据（N = 228,242），并结合联合国难民署关注人群数据库中的移民定居点数据，估计了一组双重差分回归模型。我们还测试了个人教育程度是否调节流离失所的影响。我们发现，难民营的建立降低了两类政治信任，且这种效应在受教育程度较低的收容社区成员中更为显著。这强调了在建立新营地时，人类发展在增强收容社区应对能力方面的重要性。

articles.title_en: The gendered dimensions of an ‘herbicide revolution’: a feminist analysis of herbicide adoption in central India
articles.title_cn: “除草剂革命”的性别维度：对印度中部除草剂采用的女性主义分析
articles.abstract_en: Across much of the world weeding has primarily been a form of feminized agricultural labor. As such the rapid spread of herbicides across India, and much of the global South, has significant implications for the ways that women’s labor is employed and valued in agrarian economies. Understanding these shifts is of critical importance given global calls for agroecological or environment-friendly agriculture that respects planetary boundaries. Drawing from feminist gender and technology literature, this paper sketches out the contours of these shifting labor regimes around weed economies, arguing that increased herbicide use is both cause and symptom of a broader shift in gendered socio-ecological relations. Drawing from qualitative and ethnographic data in eastern Madhya Pradesh, India, we argue that shifts in gender relations and new social entitlements have made herbicides a viable strategy to minimize one of the more arduous tasks of paddy production, weeding. However, while herbicides may “empower” some women by enabling them to reduce their weeding burden, these shifts are crosscut by class, ethnicity/caste, and capacity for mobility. This paper then traces out three ways that women are being ambiguously impacted by herbicide use in terms of social differentiation, skill, and spaces of socialization. We argue that spatiotemporal considerations are key and while herbicides may improve women’s lives in the short-term, they amount to a long-term deskilling of critical gendered ecological knowledge. We conclude by returning to calls for more environmentally sound agriculture and work to imagine how food systems could properly value the human labor of weeding.
articles.abstract_cn: 在世界许多地方，除草主要是一种女性化的农业劳动形式。因此，除草剂在印度及全球南方大部分地区的迅速普及，对女性劳动力在农业经济中的使用和价值方式产生了重大影响。鉴于全球对尊重地球边界的生态农业或环境友好型农业的呼吁，理解这些转变至关重要。借鉴女性主义性别与技术文献，本文勾勒了围绕杂草经济的这些劳动力制度变迁的轮廓，认为除草剂使用的增加既是更广泛的性别社会-生态关系转变的原因，也是其症状。基于印度中央邦东部的定性和民族志数据，我们认为，性别关系的变化和新的社会权利使除草剂成为减少水稻生产中最为艰巨的任务之一——除草——的可行策略。然而，尽管除草剂可能通过使一些女性减少除草负担而“赋权”于她们，但这些转变受到阶级、民族/种姓和流动能力的交叉影响。本文随后追溯了除草剂使用在性别分化、技能和社交空间方面对女性产生模糊影响的三种方式。我们认为时空考量是关键，尽管除草剂可能在短期内改善女性的生活，但它们长期导致关键性别生态知识的去技能化。最后，我们回到对更环保农业的呼吁，并努力设想粮食系统如何能够恰当地重视除草的人类劳动。

articles.title_en: Institutional quality and risk depletion of natural resources: Evidence from explainable artificial intelligence modelling
articles.title_cn: 制度质量与自然资源风险耗竭：来自可解释人工智能建模的证据
articles.abstract_en: As global temperatures continue to rise, urgent action from public authorities is required to conserve natural resources more effectively, since widespread environmental degradation and overexploitation of resources already threaten ecosystems and human well-being in many parts of the world. Using data from 167 countries over the period 2007–2023, this study identifies the most effective institutional dimensions for resource preservation. The analysis utilized explainable artificial intelligence modelling to capture nonlinear and complex interactions among institutional and investment environments, business conditions, economic contexts, and infrastructure and market access, thereby generating accurate predictions and interpretable insights into the key drivers of resources conservation. The results show that land, forest, soil and freshwater resources are better protected in countries with strong political accountability and efficient regulatory institutions. From a practical standpoint, on one hand, the potential threat of electoral backlash can motivate politicians to adopt environmentally and ecologically friendly policies. On the other hand, high quality regulatory frameworks strengthen the adaptive capacity of institutions, enabling timely responses to changes in the natural environment. Additionally, strengthening these institutional dimensions should be complemented by public policies that promote affordable electricity, foster innovation, and enhance labour force engagement. Finally, our results provide supporting evidence for neo-institutional theory, emphasizing the environmental and ecological benefits of institutional legitimacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着全球气温持续上升，公共当局需要采取紧急行动以更有效地保护自然资源，因为广泛的环境退化和资源过度开发已经威胁到世界许多地区的生态系统和人类福祉。利用167个国家在2007-2023年期间的数据，本研究识别了资源保护中最有效的制度维度。分析采用了可解释人工智能建模，以捕捉制度与投资环境、商业条件、经济背景以及基础设施和市场准入之间的非线性和复杂交互作用，从而生成准确的预测和对资源保护关键驱动因素的可解释见解。结果表明，在政治问责制强且监管机构高效的国家，土地、森林、土壤和淡水资源得到了更好的保护。从实践角度来看，一方面，选举反弹的潜在威胁可以激励政治家采取环境友好和生态友好的政策。另一方面，高质量的监管框架增强了制度的适应能力，使其能够及时应对自然环境的变化。此外，加强这些制度维度应辅以促进可负担电力、推动创新和增强劳动力参与的公共政策。最后，我们的结果为新制度理论提供了支持性证据，强调了制度合法性的环境和生态效益。

articles.title_en: Women’s entrepreneurship through collective institutional shaping
articles.title_cn: 通过集体制度塑造的女性创业
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this paper is to develop an empirically informed framework to analyse how the collective shaping of institutions facilitates women’s entrepreneurship. Despite extensive literature on the impact of institutions on women’s entrepreneurship, there is limited knowledge about how diverse actors can purposively and collectively influence institutional change to create a more supportive business environment. Using the concept of collective institutional entrepreneurship, this paper explores collaborative activities within a women’s entrepreneurial ecosystem aimed at transforming institutions that constrain their entrepreneurial development. Data were gathered from semi-structured interviews with 40 participants from six groups: women entrepreneurs, government-led organisations, non-governmental organisations, business associations, financial organisations, and higher education institutions. These actors represent development programmes in Bangladesh designed to promote women’s entrepreneurship. The findings present a process model outlining steps involved in shaping institutions, including gathering actors, utilising financial resources and social positions, and seeking legitimacy for women’s entrepreneurship. The model highlights the need for a comprehensive approach to strengthen collective efforts while identifying barriers that may impact sustainable outcomes. By capturing perspectives from diverse actors and examining programmes addressing various institutional constraints, this paper offers a holistic view of women’s entrepreneurship development.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在开发一个基于实证的框架，以分析制度的集体塑造如何促进女性创业。尽管关于制度对女性创业影响的文献众多，但对于多元行动者如何有目的且集体地影响制度变革以创造更具支持性的商业环境，所知有限。利用集体制度创业的概念，本文探讨了女性创业生态系统内的合作活动，旨在转变制约其创业发展的制度。数据来源于对40名参与者的半结构化访谈，这些参与者来自六个群体：女性企业家、政府主导组织、非政府组织、商业协会、金融机构和高等教育机构。这些行动者代表了孟加拉国旨在促进女性创业的发展项目。研究结果呈现了一个过程模型，概述了塑造制度的步骤，包括聚集行动者、利用财政资源和社会地位，以及为女性创业寻求合法性。该模型强调了采取综合方法加强集体努力的必要性，同时识别可能影响可持续成果的障碍。通过捕捉多元行动者的视角并审视针对各种制度约束的项目，本文提供了对女性创业发展的整体视角。

articles.title_en: Do social and humanitarian assistance mediate the impacts of conflict on lives and livelihoods? Lessons from Ethiopia during the Tigray crisis
articles.title_cn: 社会和人道主义援助能否调解冲突对生活和生计的影响？来自提格雷危机期间埃塞俄比亚的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: Little is known about how conflict interacts with social assistance to affect poverty and livelihoods outcomes. Even less is understood about how conflicts disrupt government- and donor-provided social assistance, and whether humanitarian emergency assistance can fill provision gaps in situations of acute crisis. This paper draws on an exceptional and bespoke household panel dataset collected in Ethiopia’s Amhara region, just before and after the conflict in the neighbouring Tigray region spilled over into the study area in 2021 In addition to the impacts of conflict spillovers into Amhara, climate variability and drought have been hallmarks of vulnerability and food insecurity in the region for decades. Our data provides a rare opportunity to study the interaction between conflict and assistance, whilst controlling for drought which has long shaped vulnerability in the study area. The paper provides new evidence of how social assistance and humanitarian assistance can complement each other to mediate the impacts of conflict on food security and poverty in climate-stressed environments. The results demonstrate that, as the PSNP was curtailed and conflict erupted and intensified, humanitarian assistance supported many people including those no longer served by the PSNP – a heartening dynamic. This demonstrates a promising picture of what coordination across historically fragmented sectors can achieve.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于冲突如何与社会援助相互作用以影响贫困和生计结果，人们知之甚少。对于冲突如何扰乱政府和捐助者提供的社会援助，以及人道主义紧急援助能否在严重危机情况下填补供给缺口，了解甚至更少。本文利用在埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉地区收集的一个特殊且定制的家庭面板数据集，该数据集是在邻近提格雷地区冲突于2021蔓延至研究区域前后收集的。除了冲突蔓延至阿姆哈拉的影响外，气候变率和干旱数十年来一直是该地区脆弱性和粮食不安全的标志。我们的数据提供了一个难得的机会来研究冲突与援助之间的相互作用，同时控制长期影响研究区域脆弱性的干旱因素。本文提供了新的证据，表明社会援助和人道主义援助如何相互补充，以调解冲突对气候压力环境下粮食安全和贫困的影响。结果表明，随着生产安全网计划（PSNP）被削减以及冲突爆发和加剧，人道主义援助支持了许多人，包括那些不再由PSNP服务的人——这是一个令人鼓舞的动态。这展示了历史上分散的部门之间协调所能取得的令人期待的前景。
